description:
In this video, we’ll briefly look at how different PostgreSQL indexes work and mainly focus on how to choose the right index for your query and data.
We’ll compare:
• B-Tree
• Hash
• BRIN
• GIN
• GiST

And consider 4 important factors influencing your decision.
